download_policy: download only this original Zenodo source and record source metadata, checksum, license, and deterministic series roster before model execution

traffic_hourly.target_rule: all TSF series meeting frozen quality rules, selected by SHA-256 series ID order capped at 100

quality_rules.long_gap_handling: mark all histories or targets crossing the gap ineligible
quality_rules.scaling: mean and standard deviation fit on each series training range only (ddof=0)
quality_rules.roster_order: SHA-256 of source-specific series identifier ascending
